newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end slow, short session soft.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end slow, short session soft.

text.p: Dec 24 - U.S. debt futures finished a slow, holiday-shortened session slightly lower after trading in narrow ranges throughout the day. Economic data this morning that was in line with expectations had little impact on prices. After small initial movement, prices stayed in narrow ranges the remainder of the session. Exchange are closed Wednesday for Christmas. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
